claims: NFL games are available on broadcast TV networks CBS, FOX, NBC, and ABC.
NFL+ is a key platform for local and mobile NFL games.
Paramount+ is a key platform for CBS NFL games.
Peacock is a key platform for NBC NFL games.
Amazon Prime Video is a key platform for Thursday Night NFL games.
ESPN+ is a key platform for Monday Night NFL games.
YouTube TV provides NFL Sunday Ticket.
Sunday Day Games (Local) are available on FOX.
Sunday Day Games (Local) are available on CBS.
Sunday Day Games (Local) are available via Paramount+.
Sunday Day Games (Local) are available via Hulu+ Live TV.
Sunday Night Football is available on NBC.
Sunday Night Football is available on Peacock.
Sunday Night Football is available on fuboTV.
Monday Night Football is exclusively on ESPN and ABC.
Thursday Night Football is exclusively on Amazon Prime Video.
Out-of-Market Sunday Games are available via NFL Sunday Ticket on YouTube TV.
Select International Games and Special Games are available on Netflix.
Select International Games and Special Games are available on ESPN+.
Select International Games and Special Games are available on Peacock.
NFL+ offers live local and primetime games on phones and tablets.
NFL RedZone is available through NFL+ Premium.
NFL RedZone is available through many cable providers.
The NFL has a Ways to Watch tool.
Michael Saves published a 1-minute YouTube video titled "NFL Streaming Guide: How to Watch Every Game Without Cable!" on Aug 29, 2025.
